title: JANUS ONE(2) historical archaeology — Nov 2025 to Jan 2026
major_exclusions: credentials, API keys, bot tokens, recovery codes and private endpoints
raw databases, logs, personal images and conversation dumps
P-vs-NP solution claims from LLM scoring or semantic simulation
claim_boundary: Historical presence and source hashes do not prove that every archived module executed or worked.
Architecture lineage is preserved separately from current evidence authority.
No historical P-vs-NP claim enters the current proof chain by provenance alone.
No secret-bearing historical source is admitted as public executable code.
relation_to_one3: Uses the same curated-admission principle as JANUS-ONE3-HISTORICAL-ARCHIVE-TRIAGE-CAPSULE-v1.0: preserve meaning, provenance and failures without leaking secrets or promoting old executable authority.
